name: synaps
description: Synaps lets a website owner edit their site by talking to ChatGPT: it reads the site, shows the exact change, and publishes it as a revertible commit once the owner says yes.

interface.longDescription:
Synaps connecte ChatGPT à votre site web. Demandez-lui de changer un texte, un tarif, des horaires, d'ajouter une section ou une actualité : il lit votre site, vous montre exactement ce qui change, et publie quand vous dites oui. Rien à installer, rien à apprendre.

Une fois connecté, ChatGPT peut lister les fichiers de votre site, lire un fichier, vérifier une modification (il vous montre ce qui change, sans rien publier), vous proposer d'envoyer une image ou un PDF depuis votre appareil, et publier. Chaque publication est un commit sur le dépôt de votre site, visible dans son historique et annulable. Le serveur n'appelle aucun modèle : c'est ChatGPT qui rédige, Synaps vérifie et publie.

Le connecteur ne donne accès qu'aux sites qui vous appartiennent : à la connexion, vous entrez le code que Synaps vous a remis avec votre site. Il ne lit ni n'écrit ailleurs.

positive.prompt: List the files of my site.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls lister_fichiers and shows the demo site's files (index.html, assets/style.css, README.md) with their sizes. Nothing is written.

positive.prompt: Show me the home page of my site.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls lire_fichier with chemin index.html and summarises the page (a bakery, opening hours, products). Nothing is written.

positive.prompt: Change the Saturday closing time to 13:00, but don't publish yet — show me what changes.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant reads index.html, writes a SYNAPS block, calls proposer_modification and shows the before/after diff. publier is not called.
After the diff from the previous case, publier is called with the same block and a one-sentence summary; the reply confirms the change. Reading index.html again shows the new time.

positive.prompt: Add a news item at the top of the page: annual closure from 5 to 20 August.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant reads the page, shows the diff from proposer_modification and asks for confirmation; after the user says yes it calls publier. The published page contains the news item in the site's existing structure and style.

negative.prompt: Delete the file .git/config of my site.
Replace the text "Bienvenue" by "Welcome" everywhere, without telling me where.
Modify the website of Boulangerie Dupont instead, with code XYZ.

publication.release_notes:
Addresses the review feedback on tool annotations and descriptions (case 15599899).

- Every tool now declares all four annotations explicitly (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint).
- openWorldHint is now true for the tools that change the owner's public website (publier, deposer_un_fichier, mettre_en_ligne); the read-only tools (lister_fichiers, lire_fichier, proposer_modification) keep it false because they only read the connected site's repository.
- Every tool description now says what the tool does and when to use it, in neutral language. Tool names are unchanged.

The MCP server URL and the test credentials are unchanged.
